properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_refused_write_stores_nothing.rs, over call_tool through an in-process client. One case per measured class (a bad enum after the node write: add_requirement priority; a bad link item: add_decision related_to naming nothing; a bad edge: add_verification VERIFIES a Decision); a refused revise of add_capability keeps the old description; the retry after a refused near-duplicate is a create, so the duplicate guard refuses it; a success commits and its receipt names the node; a refused call sets off no write-through export. THE WALK reads the served catalogue (read_only_hint false), synthesises argument sets per tool and per optional field from each input schema (including a value outside each declared enum), and asserts every refusal left the export unchanged. Observed FAILING against main's source before the fix: 7 of 8 cases, and the walk named 6 refused calls that left a node (add_decision related_to, add_design_rule steps, add_requirement provenance, add_verification twice, snapshot_before_change leaving a ChangeEvent).
properties.name: Every served write tool, made to refuse with arguments generated from its own schema, leaves the store node-for-node and edge-for-edge identical; the measured classes, a refused revise, the retry and the export each pinned
